hooks.text: Nearly 200 men at the Alamo faced a blood-red flag.
Why did a blood-red flag wave over the 1836 Alamo?
A blood-red flag in 1836 promised death to every defender.

title: Why Did the Battle of the Alamo Last Only 90 Minutes?
description: The 13-day siege of the Alamo ended in a brutal dawn assault that lasted only 90 minutes. Nearly every defender fell before the sun rose over the mission walls.
